Friends,

Can you recommend a good consultant - geography not critical - who is fairly knowledgeable about CGHs?

At the moment we (my employer) has a few opportunities. For example, in one, we'd like to be brought up-to-date about various optical properties of a "typical" pattern-generating CGH in the IR, to assist with our modeling a system that incorporates it in ZEMAX.

Do you have any recommendations about people I could contact? Feel free to respond here, or email me at gregg [at] opticsforhire.com .

Best,

Gregg
